events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...South winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 65 mph expected on
high peaks.

* WHERE...Southwestern Humboldt.

* WHEN...Until 9 AM PST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Wind gusts will be particularly strong along windward
ridges and exposed coastal headlands.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High winds aloft along the Del Norte Coast
have the potential to mix down to the surface leading to stronger
winds (potential gusts up to 60 mph). The strongest winds are
expected Tuesday morning/early afternoon.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Northern Coastal Humboldt; Southeastern Interior Humboldt
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Northern Coastal Humboldt and Southeastern Interior
Humboldt.

* WHEN...From 10 PM this evening to 4 PM PST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Wind gusts will be particularly strong along windward
ridges and exposed coastal headlands. There is an increased risk of
tree branches and other debris on roadways. Gusty winds will blow
around unsecured objects. Tree limbs could be blown down and a few
power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strong winds aloft are likely to mix down to
the surface during this time period.
